themes.description: This theme covers user suggestions for new features, enhancements, or modifications to existing functionalities within the platform.
Covers general satisfaction, ease of use, and overall sentiment about the application.
Addresses feedback on specific feature design, user interface changes, and usability of particular functionalities.
Relates to the success or failure of investment activities, such as IPO allotments, and the perceived fairness or effectiveness of related services.
This theme covers requests for new features, missing functionalities, or enhancements to existing app features.
This theme covers concerns related to data privacy, security breaches, unauthorized access, or spam related to personal information.
This theme covers requests for new features or complaints about the absence of desired functionalities in the application.
This theme addresses issues related to data privacy, unauthorized data sharing, account security, and potential fraudulent activities.
Concerns related to user data privacy, potential data breaches, unauthorized sharing of personal information, and security vulnerabilities.
